display.title: Episode 388: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa's Stone for the Beis HaMikdash (Rosh Chodesh Av)
display.summary_short: On Rosh Chodesh Av, poor Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa finds a perfect stone for the Beis HaMikdash and angels help him carry it, plus Rosh Chodesh, a listeners' letter and Shabbos Chazon.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on the eve of Rosh Chodesh Av 5749, during the Three Weeks, with no music. Uncle Yossi explains that the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed for lack of Ahavas Yisroel, and that loving one another will bring the third. Story time: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, too poor to bring a gift for building the Beis HaMikdash, prays by the roadside and realizes the perfectly square stone he is sitting on could be a cornerstone. After a boy recites the Shema, the story continues: the stone is too heavy, but five angels disguised as travelers offer to help, and it floats toward Yerushalayim only once he places his little finger on it. Every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash, and 'you try your best and Hashem will do the rest'. Uncle Yossi explains why Rosh Chodesh is the 'head' of the month, reads a letter and describes a drawing of Har Sinai from two schoolgirls, teaches that the month of Av calls for ending baseless hatred, and closes with Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berditchev's teaching that on Shabbos Chazon tzaddikim glimpse the third Beis HaMikdash.
display.lesson: Try your best and Hashem will do the rest; every mitzvah adds a stone to the third Beis HaMikdash.

advisories.note: Talks about the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash and the mourning of the Three Weeks and Av.
